title: Events after the Reporting Date
summary: Prescribes when entities adjust for events after the reporting date, what to disclose about the authorization-for-issue date, and going-concern assessment – with post-reporting-date events that arose AFTER the reporting date disclosed, not adjusted. Effective 1 January 2008 (revised edition that superseded the 2001 original).
description: IPSAS 14 Events after the Reporting Date prescribes the accounting and disclosure for events occurring between the reporting date and the date the financial statements are authorized for issue.
